Date: 25-07-2026
                      Common PG Admission Timeline 2026-27

       Applications are invited from eligible candidates for the admission in Post-
graduate degree courses available in Morigaon College(A) for the session 2026-27. The
timeline for PG Admission is given below. All the admission of PG Courses will be
conducted only by the Samarth Portal.

                         Activity                                  Dates
       Registration and Application:                24th - 30th July, 2026
       Correction window:                           31st July, 2026
       Scrutiny of Applications:                    1st to 4th August, 2026
       Preparation and locking of 1st Merit list:   5th August, 2026 (Till 12:30 P.M.)
       Publication of the 1st Merit List:           5th August, 2026 (By 5 P.M.)
       Admission of the 1st Merit list:             6th and 7th August, 2026
       Preparation and locking of 2nd Merit list:   8th August, 2026 (Till 12:30 P.M.)
       Publication of the 2nd Merit list:           8th August, 2026 (By 5 P.M.)
       Admission of 2nd Merit list:                 10th - 11th August,2026
       Spot admission:                              12th – 14th August, 2026


                                 The URL for PG admissions:

                    https://assamadmission.samarth.ac.in/pg/index.php/



                                                                       Sd/-
                                                             Dr. Lila Kanta Barthakur
                                                                     Principal
                                                              Morigaon College (A)
